description: A two-document corpus as scopus_corpus() (R) and corpus() (Python) return it, for the corpus writer's shared golden, golden-corpus.json. Both documents cite works W (Scopus id 111) and X (222), with their DOIs present in one bibliography and absent from the other, and written in different cases and with a resolver prefix. Document B came back without its own Scopus identifier, which a reference in A supplies through B's DOI. 'attributes' holds what the builders attach to their result. The Python suite reads the same file, byte for byte.
